note: Large-binary policy (GOVERNANCE/LARGE_BINARIES.md): cases.jsonl exceeds 10 MB and is kept out of history by the local .gitignore. It is a deterministic merge of rows/*.json (sorted by case_id, method); archives are content-addressed under archives/ and listed with hashes in archives_manifest.sha256.

cases.jsonl.regenerate_from_scratch: freeze is fixed; rerun 'benchmark --split confirmation --resume' and '--split transfer --resume' on a fresh copy of freeze.json+freeze.sha256 under a new run id
